content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-005 Interactive Bash From www-data Service Context) AND (BIOC(MP-005 NGFW Outbound HTTP Beacon To Known IOC Domain) OR BIOC(MP-005 Identity Kerberos PreAuth Failure Burst From One Client))) WITHIN 30s GROUP BY src_host HAVING count_distinct(_product) >= 2
rules.name: Cross-Plane Stitch — EDR Plus NDR Plus ITDR From One Source Host
